name: MCP Secrets
description: A secure secrets management server that enables LLMs to execute CLI commands using injected credentials while protecting sensitive data through output redaction and user-approved session permissions. It features an encrypted vault, secret capture from command outputs, and a macOS menu bar app for native notifications and dialogs.
